_comment: Seed data for the Winning Email Library, extracted from real Aeon Sign and Aeon Miles templates already in use. Each entry maps to an EmailTemplate + one approved EmailTemplateVersion, per CLAUDE.md's schema. generation_source is 'human' for all of these (pre-existing, not AI-drafted) so they are safe to use as few-shot grounding examples immediately. org_id/persona/workflow_position fields are placeholders to be set to real ObjectIds once Organization records exist.

aeon_sign_templates.notes: Full body copy for each of these is in the source documents (Aeon_Sign_Amazon.docx, Aeon_Sign_FedEx.docx, Aeon_Sign_Final_Cold_Email_Templates.docx) — paste full bodies into EmailTemplateVersion.body_html per entry when seeding. sequence.notes: Placed after email 2, not before. Goal is discovery, not closing. If asked pricing, redirect to understanding their current setup first.

sequence.subject: One area worth taking a closer look at
You don't have to outsource everything
sequence.notes: Answers the unstated objection 'why would I outsource my operation' — start-small framing

sequence.subject: Could we start with one area?
sequence.notes: Keep this one shorter than the others

Final human touch after email 6. Keep quick, not a 'desperate final attempt' tone. If 'not right now': ask about later in the year (this is the recycle/win-back branch point). If 'interested': exit automation immediately into the sales process.

exit_conditions: Reply indicates interest → move out of automation into sales process immediately (do not continue the sequence)
Reply/call indicates 'not now' → offer nurture (later-in-year) branch rather than continuing the same cadence — this is the real-world precedent for the Lost+Recycle/win-back design in CLAUDE.md
aeon_miles_templates.notes: Full body copy is in Email_and_Calling_Aeon_Miles.docx; call scripts (including objection handling and voicemail script) are in Cold_calling_script.docx. Both should be pasted in full when seeding EmailTemplateVersion / a CallScript reference.
